name: Kisan Credit Card (Pashupalan)
benefit: - Short-term working capital loan for livestock activities through the Kisan Credit Card system. - Interest subsidy is provided on loans sanctioned under the scheme. - Expected Time of Disbursement: Typically within 15 days of application approval.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be a livestock farmer or a member of a primary agricultural credit cooperative society. 1. The applicant should require short-term working capital for livestock activities, including dairy production.
